note: *os meus ossos se colaram à minha carne*: the Latinist asked the singular *o meu osso se colou*; held (D2, D29). Tied to 138:15's held major: the two change together or neither (HANDOFF).
*e chegue até vós o meu clamor* is the versicle said at every Hour; *venha a vós* (Douay-Rheims) is the literal option.
*para outra geração*: the Latinist asked *em outra geração* twice; held, kept as an option.
